messages:
rowan: quick follow-up from the AH Q&A  capturing the concrete asks so we don't lose stuff in DMs. main points: 1) exact GA date window for Dedicated + signup flow, 2) who owns the customer migration checklist, 3) where marketing can pull beta copy.

ana: GA window = Sept 30  final day still under minor review but this is what leadership approved today. signup flow = landing -> signup form -> sales triage. i'll post the landing URL and the form by Tue.

mira: i'll take the migration checklist and SE handoff doc. plan: PR to infra/docs with a preflight, terraform/helm examples, and a short troubleshooting section. ETA: next-wed.

devon: marketing note: please send me the beta teaser copy by July 10 if you want it in the newsletter. also, i'll pull FAQ bullets from the landing doc once it's live.

sam: ops checklist snippet i'm going to include in the runbook:
```
# runtime tuning (example)
--batch-window-ms=9
--max-batch=200
--kv-cache-ttl=3600
```
will also add a brief "what to monitor" panel for SEs.

deploy-bot: Notice: doc "dedicated-ga-plan" updated by ana 8h ago9 changelog: "provisional GA + signup flow added"

rowan: action items (owners):
- ana: publish landing + signup form by Tue (owner: ana)
- mira: migration checklist + SE playbook PR by next-wed (owner: mira)
- devon: beta teaser + FAQ pull by July 10 (owner: devon)
- sam: add monitoring panels + example alerts in infra dashboards by Fri (owner: sam)
I'll convert to tickets in Asana and tag owners. if you want to be cc'd on the marketing thread add yourself here. thanks :pray:
